🧱 BlockStack

A block swings back and forth — click or tap at the right moment to drop it and stack it perfectly on the block below. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Watch the swinging block and click/tap to drop it.
  2. Time your drop to align with the block below.
  3. Only the overlapping portion stacks — the rest falls away.
  4. Misalignments accumulate, making each level more precise.
  5. Perfect alignment every time = maximum tower height.
